items.text: Jadarian Price listed among players out for Sunday; aggravated chest injury.
items.implication: Seahawks RBBC further thinned; Charbonnet practicing post-ACL.
items.opportunity: More work for remaining Seahawks RBs (Wilson/Holani).

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury, limited practice all week.
items.implication: More targets available in Eagles passing game vs Rams (Donald also out).
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Eagles WRs/TEs; reverse any prior beneficiary assumptions if unexpectedly active.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.implication: Jordan Addison elevated as primary WR option vs Miami.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Addison and other Vikings pass-catchers.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.implication: Full backfield opportunity for backups vs Bears.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jets RBs in Hall's absence.

items.text: Dallas Goedert included in players out for Sunday.
items.why: Injury (unspecified in list; part of multi-out report).
items.implication: Eagles TE targets shift with Smith also out.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.why: Rib injury; intends to play through with padding.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, Kittle/others rise.
items.opportunity: If active, full role; if OUT, beneficiaries gain snaps/targets.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price through first month in NFL: Lost goal-line (and some base) work to Emmanuel Wilson; Lost pass-down work to George Holani; Lost fumbles in back-to-back games; Is hurt (chest); Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. That said, Price passes eye test and has run well when given chances. Far, far, far from over for Price longer-term. Projections updated for Price (chest).
items.why: Role loss + fumbles + injury + Charbonnet return; still positive long-term eye test.
items.implication: Short-term fantasy hit; monitor Charbonnet activation.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/pass-down shares shifted away; reverse if Price unexpectedly active.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.implication: Full Lamar usage expected; Ravens offense unlocked.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/rush share restored for Jackson and skill players.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Returned to practice; cleared on final report.
items.implication: Stroud efficiency boost; Collins WR1 role vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: Full target share/routes restored after two-game absence.

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.implication: Nacua back in high-volume role vs Eagles (Smith also out).
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets restored; boosts Stafford and Rams pass game.

items.text: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation recovery; practiced limited but ruled out.
items.implication: Mariota or backup starts in London vs Colts.
items.opportunity: Reduced rushing upside for Commanders offense.

items.text: Sadly, Omarion Hampton is on the Week 4 Hate List. RB27 in utilization with just 3.5% target share and 25% route participation; snap rate dropped to 42% in Week 3, only 13% third-down. Seattle allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Low usage metrics + tough Seahawks run defense + trailing script risk.
items.implication: Sit in most formats; limited opportunity.

items.text: Only a 4-game sample. But with Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share. With Sampson healthy for most of 2025, Judkins was at 8.3%. Judkins now on pace to catch 64 passes.
items.why: Sampson absence driving higher pass involvement.
items.implication: Judkins emerging as pass-catching RB with elevated target share/pace.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share, route work in Browns offense.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on the LOVE list as a top 10 play this week. Led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, handling 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out. Cleveland allows big RB yards.
items.why: 90% snaps, near-full touch share with Dowdle out again; strong matchup.
items.implication: Workhorse RB2/flex with high floor/ceiling on TNF.
items.opportunity: Dominant snap/carry/target share in Steelers backfield.
